title: Storage-Condition Watch for Collectibles
dataSources: Collection items (`collection:item`), vinyl plays (`vinyl:play`), LEGO sets (`lego:set`), trading-card prices (`tradingcard:price`).
app: Collection catalogues and price APIs — Discogs (vinyl), BrickLink (LEGO), trading-card and coin/stamp price feeds, and personal inventory databases with NFC-tagged scans — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=collection:item
| eval risk=case(humidity>60,"too damp",humidity<30,"too dry",temp>25,"too warm",1=1,"ok")
| stats latest(risk) as risk, latest(humidity) as humidity, latest(temp) as temp by location
| where risk!="ok"
description: Watches the temperature and humidity where sensitive collectibles are stored and warns when conditions risk damage.
value: Paper, vinyl, and cards degrade in damp or heat; an environment check protects a collection that took years to build.
implementation: Ingest storage-area sensors tagged to collections; alert when conditions leave the safe range.
visualization: Table of storage locations with out-of-range conditions.
grandmaExplanation: It watches the temperature and damp where you keep collectibles and warns before conditions can damage them.
